passkey.unavailableHint: Passkeys are not offered at this address. To sign in with one, open Meshloom over https on an address declared in Settings, or on localhost.
passkey.insecureHint: Passkeys are not available here: they need https on a declared address or localhost.

errors.cancelled: The passkey request was cancelled. Try again.
errors.notAllowed: The passkey request was cancelled, refused or timed out. Try again.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This device already has a passkey for this account.
errors.failed: The browser could not use a passkey here. Try again or use another method.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.help: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of your password. Your password keeps working. A passkey works only on the address it was created on.
passkeys.ingress: Passkeys do not apply under Home Assistant: Home Assistant already signed you in.
passkeys.noPassword: This account has no Meshloom password (it signs in another way), so it has no passkeys.
passkeys.unavailable: Adding a passkey needs https on a declared public address, Meshloom Remote or localhost, in a browser that supports passkeys. Over plain http on the local network it is not available.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.codeHelp: Enter a code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. A recovery code is used up as soon as you submit it, even if you then cancel the passkey prompt: you would need another one to try again. A passkey replaces both your password and your code when signing in, which is why both are asked.
